anchors.description: White built-in dishwasher under the counter, horizontal distance between the left and right front-panel edges (panel plane), standard 24-inch (0.61 m) dishwasher width.
anchors.visible_evidence: White two-panel under-counter appliance between the sink cabinet and the black glass-front cooler; its left and right front edges are visible at x about 294 and 420 px at y about 405 px in the original image.
